children: If you want to show off your costume on stage or compete for craftsmanship/skit performance, please fill out the masquerade application form! Applications are open to everyone—regardless of skill—and we strongly encourage applying early to secure a spot.
The form will remain open until all timeslots are filled.
We are unable to compensate masquerade participants. Please purchase a ticket before coming to ScottyCon.

children: Sign up to volunteer for ScottyCon! All volunteers receive a free ticket, and volunteers who sign up for 3+ hours receive a free staff T-shirt. Roles include Arcade Machine Supervisor, Entrance/Exit Guide, ScottyCon Merch Table, Snacks & Food Table, Photographer, and more!
